messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: 3 pings for networking instability in eu-west-1c — multiple backend ELBs reporting unhealthy targets and elevated 5xx. Paging: @Alex (oncall) @Priya. Incident channel opened.
Alex (oncall): I'm awake, looking now. any customer-facing alerts?
Claire-CS: seeing 12% of EU requests returning 502/504 since ~02:12 UTC, several customers reporting degraded inference latency.
Mika: running quick healthcheck across ELBs in eu-west-1: eu-west-1a/1b look ok, 1c has high connection resets to backend instances.
Jordan-SRE: confirm high SYN_RECV and TX retransmits on ENIs in 1c. Netstat dump shows repeated RSTs.
Alex (oncall): grabbing ELB target health - can we drain affected targets and shift traffic to healthy AZs? what's Route53 TTL?
Priya (handoff): TTL is 60s on weighted records. I'll prepare a weighted shift. Alex, can you start a temporary drain on the sick targets so we stop routing new sessions into them?
Alex (oncall): running this:
```bash
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-1:tg/xxxx
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-1:tg/xxxx --targets Id=i-0a1b2c3d
```
Deregistered 3 targets in eu-west-1c, health checks still showing unhealthy for ones that remain.
Mika: starting weighted shift: set eu-west-1 weight 1c -> 10%, 1a+1b -> 90%. Doing gradual to avoid cache thrash.
Priya (handoff): I'm taking console — @Alex handing off after you've finished deregisters. I'll coordinate Route53 changes and AWS SR ticket.
Alex (oncall): Handoff ack, moving to watch-only. Leaving notes: saw ENI flaps ~02:08-02:14. Instance-side network stack okay, kernel conntrack entries spike. Suspect underlying hypervisor networking or host NIC firmware.
Jordan-SRE: Captured tcpdump from a healthy instance and an affected one. Difference: affected shows repeated ICMP unreachable from local hypervisor. Pasted excerpt: `ICMP Destination Host Unreachable from 10.0.5.1`
Mika: Applied routing weight change. Quick stats: 502s dropped from 12% -> 6% after shifting 60% traffic out of 1c. Still seeing some errors attributed to long-lived connections remaining on unhealthy targets.
Claire-CS: Notified top 5 impacted accounts, providing workaround (switch region or retry). Asking for ETA for mitigation to share.
Priya (handoff): Kicking off AWS Support case — include packet captures and ENI IDs. Filing now. SR# 987654321. AWS initial response queued.
incidents-bot: AWS SR acknowledged, case route: networking team engaged.
Mika: As a second mitigation, enabling ELB connection drain timeout reduce from 300 -> 30s to force faster cutover for clients holding connections to drained targets. Command posted below.
```bash
aws elbv2 modify-load-balancer-attributes --load-balancer-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-1:lb/yyy --attributes Key=idle_timeout.timeout_seconds,Value=30
```
Jordan-SRE: FYI, reduced idle timeout will drop some in-flight requests but accelerates healing. Tradeoff: short spikes of 5xx for faster overall normalization.
Alex (oncall): Any sign of EBS or EC2 control plane? I/O metrics look normal for EBS, only network counters spiking for those ENIs.
Priya (handoff): AWS support reports they see 'hypervisor link flap' affecting placement group within eu-west-1c — working on host isolation. They've asked us to move critical instances out of affected hosts.
Mika: Spawning replacement ASG instances in eu-west-1c with different tenancy/placement to force new hosts. am deploying new AMI with same config.
Claire-CS: Customers asking about SLA impact. Current estimate: degraded for ~30-45m, affecting EU-region inference endpoints primarily. I'm prepping a status page blurb.
Alex (oncall): Good call on replacements. If AWS isolates hosts, we should see ENI flaps stop. Watching metrics.
Priya (handoff): Route53 weight now at 95% 1a+1b, 5% 1c to allow residual traffic. TTL still 60s. Reducing to 30s might speed rebalancing but increases DNS churn — keeping at 60 for now.
Mika: New instances registered to target groups, health checks passing for replacements. Starting blackhole for old instance IDs via deregister.
incidents-bot: Noted customer impact annotation: 502 spike, eu-west-1 customers ~peak 13% affected rolling average.
Jordan-SRE: After host isolation by AWS, ENI flaps subsided around 02:42 UTC. Network retransmits back to baseline.
Mika: Rolling weighted back to normal. All healthy targets across AZs. 5xx rate down to baseline 0.6%.
Claire-CS: Status page updated: mitigation in place, partial recovery. Notifying impacted customers with post-incident note and recommended mitigation (regional failover config).
Priya (handoff): Closing handoff: I'll remain to watch for 30 mins then hand back to Alex for full cleanup and postmortem writeup.
Alex (oncall): Thanks team. I'll pick up postmortem and timeline. Main action items: 1) postmortem with RCA (hypervisor link flapping), 2) consider routing policy changes to reduce single-AZ exposure for critical inference endpoints, 3) test faster DNS failover and traffic gating in DR runbook.
incidents-bot: Incident declared mitigated at 02:48 UTC. Monitoring for recurrence for next 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
